SELECT tmp1.equMark, tmp1.indentifyMark, tmp1.registBankCode, NVL(tmp1.fundAccPlace,tmp2.fundAccPlace) fundAccPlace, NVL(tmp1.theBankCode,tmp2.agencyCode) agencyCode, tmp2.orgIndentifyMark FROM( SELECT 'SUB' equMark, INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode, FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, THE_BANK_CODE theBankCode FROM CHB_EQU_SUB WHERE FUND_ACC_PLACE is NULL OR THE_BANK_CODE is NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CHECK' equMark, INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode, FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, THE_BANK_CODE theBankCode FROM CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK WHERE FUND_ACC_PLACE is NULL OR THE_BANK_CODE is NULL ) tmp1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT(ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK) as orgIndentifyMark, INDENTIFY_MARK as indentifyMark, FUND_ACC_PLACE as fundAccPlace, NVL(AGENCY_CODE,REGIST_BANK_CODE) as agencyCode FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE TO_CHAR(EQUITY_CONF_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group BY ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, AGENCY_CODE, INDENTIFY_MARK, FUND_ACC_PLACE) tmp2 ON tmp1.indentifyMark = tmp2.orgIndentifyMark GROUP BY tmp1.equMark, tmp1.indentifyMark, tmp1.registBankCode, tmp2.fundAccPlace, tmp2.agencyCode, tmp2.orgIndentifyMark

SELECT 'SUB' equMark, indentifyMark, registBankCode, fundAccPlace, agencyCode, orgIndentifyMark FROM （ SELECT indentifyMark, registBankCode, fundAccPlace, agencyCode, orgIndentifyMark, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by tmp.indentifyMark order by tmp.tableNo,tmp.UPDATE_TIME desc ) indMarkNo FROM（ SELECT '02' tableNo, B.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, B.REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode, B.FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, B.THE_BANK_CODE agencyCode, B.INDENTIFY_MARK orgIndentifyMark, B.UPDATE_TIME FROM ( select * from CHB_EQU_SUB where NVL(TO_CHAR(UPDATE_TIME,'yyyy-mm-dd'),TO_CHAR(CREATE_TIME,'yyyy-mm-dd')) = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and STATUS = '02' and ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK is null and (FUND_ACC_PLACE is NULL OR THE_BANK_CODE is NULL) ) A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK
UNION ALL
